title: dupe arrows
body: Is there a way to dupe arrows using this mod?
author: cyf680

comments.body: Using the original mod to dupe just cannot work in survival mode and changing the delays cannot work either.
is it due to the different phases of drawing a bow?

At the current state of the mod, I'm pretty sure you can "dupe" arrows. However, there's a few things to note.

-You're not actually "duping" the arrows, you're just shooting tipped arrows as if they had infinity.
-The arrows you shoot cannot be picked up.
-The arrows you shoot do NOT retain the effects of the tipped arrows you shoot.
-imo, an arrow dupe wouldn't be all that useful, as you can simply trade for them with villagers
